content:
The **Sunday Brothers' Cabin** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

This large two-story cabin belonged to Jesus and Juan Diego Sunday, who lived in it before and after the Great War. They also operated a bar and moonshine distillery from their property's borders. When they decided to join the Free States, they turned their cabin and bunker into an official distillation center for the faction, producing moonshine for the Free States and their affiliates. They worked closely with Vault-Tec University students to create accelerated distillation machinery after the Great War. The two of them defended their livelihood, setting up a profitable relationship with Harpers Ferry, trading Moonshine for ammunition. [1] 

After the fall of Harpers Ferry to the Scorchbeasts, Brianna Hawke and survivors arrived at the cabin, following JD. Jesus believed that she was manipulating his brother and scared them away with a shotgun, refusing to share their supplies with them. [2] However, Juan continued to give them supplies in secret. When Jesus discovered it, he decided to confront his brother. It culminated in a gun battle during which Jesus shot his own brother, Hawke's group set fire to the fields around the cabin, losing most of their number to the flames, and Jesus himself died of a gunshot wound on top of the rocky outcrop. [3] 

Afterward, a group of Raiders; including Asher, Clay, Petey and Slayer, found the cabin, a robot in its basement, and decided to make the place their new home. [4] Slayer managed to get the robot functional, naming it Moonshiner Ned. [5] [6] 

The Raiders held a housewarming party, with Moonshine distilled by Ned, resulting in a collective hangover the next day. [7] [8] Continued drinking caused many Raiders to disband. [9] Slayer and Ned ended up being the only remaining inhabitants, with Slayer remaining drunk due to consuming Moonshine, resulting in his death. [10] 

The property consists of the namesake two-story tall cabin, two sheds, a derelict greenhouse with a water cistern near it, and several shipping containers scattered across the property. Three alcohol stills are also present, and need to be protected during the Event: Moonshine Jamboree.

Originally the home of the Sunday Brothers, the cabin's exterior has received several makeshift fortifications and roof access when the Raiders moved in. The cabin has three entrances on the ground level, one on the northern side, and two on the southern side. The first floor contains a small bedroom with a bunk bed in the northwestern corner, a large living area with a long bar and two fireplaces, and a bathtub used for storing Acidic Gulper Venom during the event. The stairs in the middle of the living room lead up to the second floor.

The second floor only has some metal shelves and a small bedroom in the southwest corner, the latter containing a bunk bed with the corpse of Slayer on it. A doorway to the north leads to a balcony, which has a ramp granting access to the roof on the western side. The roof itself only has the corpse of Petey and a loudspeaker mast.

On the first floor, behind the bar, a set of stairs leads down to the basement, which is locked behind a Level-1 door. The basement contains a kitchen with oven and two fridges on the northeastern side, and a bathroom with a shower stall on the southeastern side. There are also several shelves, lockers, two Beds, and a Level-2-locked Safe.

The large barn stands on the eastern end of the property. It houses a desk with a terminal on it, and a Level-2-locked floor Safe next to it. There are also a Weapons Workbench, Tinker's Workbench, Chemistry Station, and Brewing Station. A cooking stove is located outside it, next to the first set of stills.

The greenhouse is located to the southwest, next to a rock formation with a water cistern. Other than a note, it has few items of interest. The rock formation above the greenhouse is the final resting place for Jesus Sunday.

The Sunday Brothers' Cabin appears in *Fallout 76*.
